description.p: miz turns whatever your computer is playing — a music app, a browser, anything — into slow, flowing visuals made for listening: feedback tunnels, a stereo scope, a radial spectrum and a nebula, with gentle crossfades between them.

ul.li: Listens only to what you hear (the monitor of the default output), never to a microphone: Bluetooth headphones keep their high-quality profile and other apps keep their mic
Photosensitivity limiter in every mode: the picture's average brightness cannot change fast enough to flash
Calm mode by default, energetic mode one key away
Light on the CPU and battery; slows down when nothing is playing
Small settings menu, keyboard shortcuts and a documented config file that applies while running
